title: Nature
subtitle: Development preview of the forest, beach, ice and abstract templates.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 01 · FOREST
chapters.heading: Snow holds the high ground long after the valley thaws.
chapters.body: A development preview of the Peak scene, used to tune the layers, the camera climb and the light for each time of day. It is not a story and never appears in the gallery or in production builds of the site.
